# TaxClear — India Income Tax Calculator

> Free old vs new tax regime calculator for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27).

## Summary
TaxClear helps Indian taxpayers compare liability under the old and new income tax regimes. It includes Section 87A rebate, surcharge, Health & Education Cess (4%), HRA, Chapter VI-A deductions, senior citizen slabs, and support for salaried, pension, and business income.

## Primary URL
https://newtaxcalculator.vercel.app/

## Key facts (AY 2026-27 / FY 2025-26)
- New regime is the default.
- New slabs: 0–4L nil, 4–8L 5%, 8–12L 10%, 12–16L 15%, 16–20L 20%, 20–24L 25%, above 24L 30%.
- New regime standard deduction (salary/pension): ₹75,000.
- Section 87A (new): rebate up to ₹60,000 if taxable income ≤ ₹12 lakh (resident).
- Salaried effectively tax-free up to about ₹12.75 lakh under new regime (std deduction + 87A).
- Old regime (below 60): 0–2.5L nil, 2.5–5L 5%, 5–10L 20%, above 10L 30%.
- Old regime senior exemption ₹3L; super senior ₹5L.
- Old regime standard deduction: ₹50,000; 87A rebate up to ₹12,500 if income ≤ ₹5L.
- Health & Education Cess: 4% on tax + surcharge (both regimes).

## Features
- Quick and Detailed calculation modes
- Old vs new side-by-side comparison
- HRA, 80C, 80D, NPS, home loan, let-out property
- Senior / super-senior / NRI handling
- Light and dark theme
